subject: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: renewals@github.com, ejohnson@jetbrains.com, atlassian-sales@atlassian.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

Hi all,

We have overlapping renewals for GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains, and Atlassian in Q1–Q2. Finance/Procurement asked us to explore: (1) possible bundled or multi-vendor discounts, (2) flexible billing (annual vs. quarterly invoicing), and (3) seat optimization to reduce wasted seats.

Attached is our current seat export and a proposed timeline. Can each vendor send a consolidated quote that includes:
- list price and any available bundle/volume discounts
- billing cadence options and lead times for PO/invoice changes
- any migration/seat reallocation admin fees

Internal folks: please confirm the seat counts in seat_counts_export_2026-02.csv and flag any teams that will reduce or increase seats by Mar 1. We need vendor quotes by EOD 2026-02-13 to hit procurement deadlines.

Thanks — laura

Attachment: seat_counts_export_2026-02.csv (CSV, 1 file)
From: GitHub Renewals <renewals@github.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-11T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

Hi Laura / team,

Thanks for the note — attached is a preliminary GitHub Enterprise renewal quote (GHE_renewal_quote_Q1-2026.pdf). Highlights:
- Standard enterprise renewal with 12% multi-year discount if you commit 24 months.
- We can offer a 6% volume credit if total seat count across product line (GitHub + other vendor partner programs) exceeds 3,000 seats — would need vendor coordination.
- Billing: annual invoicing preferred, but we can accommodate quarterly invoicing at a 2% fee to cover admin.

Question: your seat export shows a number of inactive seats under the infra team. If you can confirm expected active seats on Mar 1, we can provide an update to the quote.

Attachment: GHE_renewal_quote_Q1-2026.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Best,
Maya Rao
Renewals, GitHub
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: renewals@github.com, ejohnson@jetbrains.com, atlassian-sales@atlassian.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-12T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

Thanks, Maya.

Per engineering and procurement review: we can commit to an adjusted active seat baseline (see proposed_seat_allocation_v2.csv). Key notes:
- Reduce infra team allocation by ~8% (deactivate unused seats over 30 days).
- Consolidate contractor seats under a single pool (estimated 120 seats) to be moved between teams.
- We are open to a 24-month commit if the cross-vendor volume credit is substantive — please indicate what coordination you would need from GitHub to participate.

Internal: Neha — will quarterly invoicing with small admin fee be acceptable for cashflow if it allows us to stagger renewals? Monica — legal will need to review any redlines; Marcus, please confirm if procurement can accept quarterly invoicing for GitHub while keeping JetBrains and Atlassian annual.

Attachment: proposed_seat_allocation_v2.csv (CSV, 1 file)

On Thu, Feb 11, 2026 at 13:05, GitHub Renewals <renewals@github.com> wrote:
> [GitHub quote attached — see GHE_renewal_quote_Q1-2026.pdf]

— laura
From: JetBrains Account Exec <ejohnson@jetbrains.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-14T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

Hi Laura — 

Thanks for the RFP. Attached is the JetBrains enterprise quote (JetBrains_enterprise_quote.xlsx). A couple of items to note:
- We can extend a 10% discount if you bundle JetBrains with Atlassian products via our partner program; we'd need a joint contact from Atlassian to enable the bundle pricing.
- License reallocation is allowed twice per year at no charge for enterprise editions.
- We can issue quarterly invoices without an admin fee for enterprise accounts on file.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call with your procurement team and Atlassian sales to go over combined pricing scenarios.

Attachment: JetBrains_enterprise_quote.xlsx (XLSX, 1 file)

Best,
Ellen Johnson
Account Executive, JetBrains
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

Quick internal note —

1) Monica: prioritize the GitHub T&Cs (I flagged the rate-limiter / data retention clause in the draft — we should push for the customer-friendly version). I want the redline back by EOD 2026-02-17 so legal can brief execs.
2) Neha: quarterly invoicing for GitHub is acceptable for cashflow; please confirm implication for year-end accruals.
3) Marissa: confirm with infra team that the 8% reduction is actionable by Mar 1; if not, circle back with list of exceptions.

We'll consolidate vendor calls next week only if the bundle upside > 8%. If JetBrains can confirm the 10% with Atlassian and GitHub confirms cross-vendor coordination, we proceed with the joint negotiation.

— Marcus
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: renewals@github.com, ejohnson@jetbrains.com, atlassian-sales@atlassian.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Consolidated renewals: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian — seats, billing, and timeline

All —

Status update and next steps:
- GitHub: awaiting redlined T&Cs from Monica; Maya indicated they can do quarterly invoicing with 2% admin fee. We are exploring a 24-month commit only if cross-vendor volume credit proves material.
- JetBrains: Ellen confirmed the 10% bundle discount is possible if Atlassian participates.
- Atlassian: no formal quote yet — Marcus will reach out to their rep and ask for a bundle enablement note.

Action items:
- Monica: please upload GitHub redline (redlined_Terms_GitHub.docx) to the Drive link and share by 2026-02-17 (if delayed, escalate).
- Neha: prepare pro forma for quarterly vs annual payment scenarios and post to the linked Drive folder.
- Marissa: finalize seat deactivations for infra by Mar 1 and confirm exceptions list.
- Marcus: coordinate a three-way pricing sync with JetBrains + Atlassian next week if both vendors can commit to a bundle path.

I'll assemble vendor quotes and a recommended execution plan for procurement by 2026-02-20. If we want to lock pricing today, we can sign conditional paperwork; otherwise hold until legal clears redlines.

Draft contract link (pending GitHub redlines): https://docusign.com/prepare/DocuSignLink-GitHub-DEAL-2026-0143

Thanks,
Laura
Head of Developer Productivity Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlined_Terms_GitHub.docx (DOCX, 1 file)
